findings.title: Relay enrollment events alone cannot yield the canonical roster
findings.problem_conceded: R1 said a later enrollment supersedes an earlier one and never defined 'later'. created_at is self-asserted; bags/src/subscribe.ts:25-29 already states it MUST NOT order anybody.
findings.objection_to_remedy: An approved observer key with a sequence number places a trusted sequencer inside the one function the explorer exists to perform.

options.summary: Each rebind carries ["prev", <event_id>]. Canonical binding is the chain tip. Ordering is structural; equivocation is CONFLICTED and fails closed; a missing predecessor announces itself as INSUFFICIENT.
Published snapshots archived by a third party. Already this project's documented answer in subscribe.ts.
As E-01 proposes. Works; most operationally convenient.
options.condition: Requires a SOVEREIGNTY.md disclosure row at the same rank as the Bags rows, and the explorer must render 'ordering depends on observer <id>' as loudly as UNPROVEN_LEGACY.

findings.interim_rule: No rebinding ordering may be implemented until this is settled. A second valid enrollment for one npub is INSUFFICIENT, never a silently-picked winner.

findings.title: Root equality and destination-proof coverage must be separate dimensions
findings.resolution: Four orthogonal axes: rootVerdict, destinationProofCoverage, per-member binding status, finalizableUnderCurrentLaw. No single badge collapses them.

findings.title: CONFLICTED semantics are stale under deterministic rebinding
findings.condition: Downstream of E-01; the deterministic selection law must exist before CONFLICTED can be defined against it.
findings.resolution: CONFLICTED means the governing evidence cannot resolve one deterministic binding — equivocation, unresolved tie, or committed root destination differing from the deterministic result. Multiple valid pre-finalization enrollments are normal and are not a conflict.

findings.title: TASK.md reopens the closed legacy production decision
findings.note: Stricter than the two options R1 offered, and in the direction R1's own review argued.
findings.resolution: Production finalization is fail-closed. The 50-member root is UNPROVEN_HISTORICAL: reproducible as forensic evidence, never finalizable, never a Trust & Verify PASS, never a migration exception.

findings.title: Bundled merkle.ts is predecessor Solana/equal-share architecture
findings.resolution: R2 ships no source files as reference. reconcile()'s omitted/extra/changed discipline is retained as prose vocabulary only.

findings.title: Bundled enrollment references contain superseded execution details

findings.title: Explorer data-source list is incomplete
findings.condition: The ordering-evidence entry takes its shape from whichever E-01 option is chosen.

findings.title: Independent recomputation must not become a competing protocol implementation
findings.agreed: The explorer must not invent a second protocol law.
findings.objection: E-08 prefers importing the production verifier. An explorer sharing the production library reproduces production bugs perfectly and reports REPRODUCED — a checksum of the deployment, not a check of the law.
findings.concrete_case: A shared-library explorer pointed at the R1 roster would have called selectBindingForFinalization, received legacy_roster_wallet_v0 for all 50 members, rebuilt the identical root and shown green. The bug that justifies the explorer survives the shared-library explorer.
findings.counter_proposal: Independent implementation, cross-tested byte-for-byte against frozen public vectors, with protocol-version mismatch as its own visible state. The shared artifact is the vectors, not the code.
findings.precedent_in_repo: scripts/check-vectors-frozen.mjs already hash-checks bags/vectors/pocket-address.json and crypto/vectors/test-vectors.json.

findings.title: Refine the standalone verifier portability requirement
findings.resolution: No-external-origins governs bundled assets only. User-supplied relay and RPC endpoints are permitted and must be displayed. A failed source yields INSUFFICIENT, never silent fallback. No Berm API required for /verify.

findings.title: Trust & Verify and Explorer must be complementary, not competing
findings.carveout: Blocking is a founder decision; displaying is not. The explorer shows upstream authority as fact, including the beacon implementation address and the block of its last upgrade.
findings.rationale: Per the founder ruling on B-04: global upgrade is protocol-level, so severity is high, aimability low, detectability high. Displaying it converts an uncontrollable authority into a watchable one.
findings.related_defect: bags/SOVEREIGNTY.md:34 reads 'Stronger than any Solana admin power', contradicting that ruling. The file disagrees with the decision.

findings.title: KOL/moderator agreements and ratings are roadmap, not R1/R2 scope
findings.note: Independently reached the same conclusion in session before receiving this review: static creator sub-splits are cheap and fit existing weight-range math; time-expiring leaves are a second allocation dimension and belong to a later launch.
